*Generated by `tools/structure_metrics.py`. Counts, not verdicts. Capture z is each capture reader against her own mean (current roster); `ALMOST res/stand` splits resolved hovers from standing ones (a resolved hover in a strong chapter is usually its charge, not a sag); `drag` is how many current cold-panel readers lead their chapter-to-chapter pace note with a drag word. Gates and reads may predate later edits.*
